in_marathi.name: Nag
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nag हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Nag is the name of a divine serpent, often considered a deity and the guardian of the universe. This powerful and wise creature is associated with water, rain, and fertility.
